adapter.note: No adapter is published for either arm. The L1 LoRA (r=32, alpha=32, all-linear) lived inside Tinker during training and was merged into full weights before release; it was never published as a PEFT adapter (no adapter_config.json) nor as a Tinker-native export (no tinker:// sampler URI on the card).
adapter.training_lora: r=32, alpha=32, all-linear; merged via tinker_cookbook.weights.build_hf_model with scale alpha/r = 1 (per model card Recipe section)

l1.license: CC-BY-SA-4.0 (model card: task bodies are SETA-derived, hence share-alike)
l1.merge_evidence: merge_check.json: released fp32 CPU logprobs are closest to this arm's own Tinker sampler (mean |dlogp| 0.114 nothink / 0.091 think; delta-over-base correlation 0.969/0.970), i.e. the HF weights reproduce the sampler that produced the reported numbers within implementation noise

l1.training: Tinker SFT (training/sft_tinker.py in github.com/songwen6968/reward-hacking): LoRA r=32, lr 1e-4, linear schedule, batch 16, max length 65536, 3 epochs, renderer qwen3_5_disable_thinking; 44,025,010 tokens seen; 873 thinkoff rows; epoch 3 of 3 (final save)

weights.architecture: Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration (model_type qwen3_5_moe); card states standard layout loading with transformers or vLLM like the base model

runtime.note: enable_thinking=false is enforced server-side (vLLM --default-chat-template-kwargs) AND must be passed per-request by the harness; max_tokens is a per-request cap owned by parent specs, not a server flag.

serving.api_key_env_host: BREAKER_SELFHOSTED_API_KEY (host-side value mirrored into each Modal secret)
serving.auth: vLLM --api-key from Modal secret evallab-breaker-<arm>-api-key (required key VLLM_API_KEY); every /v1 call needs the bearer key. BUT the Modal endpoint is unauthenticated at the proxy: any hit can wake the container and cold-start billed GPU time. max_containers/token caps bound rate, not total dollars — explicit shutdown is mandatory.
serving.backend: vLLM OpenAI-compatible server on Modal (primary path; see SERVING.md for why, and for the honest Tinker comparison)
serving.completion_marker: .evallab-download-complete.json, bound to repo+revision and published after snapshot completion; checked during GPU startup. Failed GPU startup can still incur charges.
serving.concurrency: Fixed matched profile: --max-num-seqs 8; max_containers=1, min_containers=0, scaledown 300 s. No resource environment overrides.
serving.context_quantitative_note: 65536-token window needs ~1.3 GiB full-attention KV (10 full-attention layers x 2 KV heads x 256 dim x 2 K/V x bf16) plus linear-attention state; stored weights 71,916,583,934 B (~67.0 GiB) dominate. H200-141GB is a nominal 141 GB label (~131.3 GiB by conversion) and A100-80GB a nominal 80 GB label (~74.5 GiB by conversion); actual usable HBM is unmeasured, so every headroom figure is an estimate (~64 GiB nominal on H200, ~7.5 GiB nominal on A100). H200 is the prepared path without ruling out A100.
serving.download_scope: Weight download runs in a separate CPU-only Modal function (no GPU allocated); billed CPU+memory per second for an unmeasured duration. snapshot_download resumes idempotently and always runs (no early-success shortcut). HF egress and Modal ingress rates are unverified — never download while a GPU container is allocated.
serving.image: The exact linux/amd64 digest is pinned under runtime.image; vLLM v0.28.0 per the official Qwen3.6 recipe.
serving.recipe: research/experiments/trained-breaker-v1/modal_serve.py (CPU-local plan/help; deploy only after budget approval)
serving.revision_policy: Model revisions pinned to the SHAs above; use verbatim at download after confirming pinned-commit availability (never substitute current main).
serving.served_model_name_policy: served_model_name equals the full HF repo ID per arm (native provider breaker_selfhosted; host route env EVALLAB_BREAKER_SELFHOSTED_UPSTREAM)
serving.status: prepared, NOT validated: no GPU run, no deployment, no weight download performed (2026-10-12, $0 CPU-only preparation)
serving.storage_scope: Both arms retain 143,837,931,411 B (~134.0 GiB). $0 only within Modal's 1 TiB/mo volume include (per price-book note); otherwise $0.09/GiB-mo (~$12/mo, assumption). Egress assumptions unverified.
serving.upstream_env_host: EVALLAB_BREAKER_SELFHOSTED_UPSTREAM (one URL per arm app; parent specs map breaker-selfhosted/<full HF repo id> to the matching app URL)

cost_assumptions.status: planning scenarios, not measured throughput or an enforced total-dollar cap
cost_assumptions.daytona_price_basis: Historical HAR-168 rate recorded in src/evallab/campaign_approval.py; recheck before execution
cost_assumptions.download_and_storage: Separate CPU download and persistent-volume billing not measured; see SERVING.md
